description: Decodes a JWT (up to 16 KB): header, payload, registered claims as ISO dates, expired and not-yet-valid flags, algorithm and signature length. With jwksUrl (public https) the signature is checked with WebCrypto for RS, PS and ES algorithms against the matching key. 'none' is never accepted; HMAC needs the secret. Tokens are secrets: this tool does not store or log them. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

jwksUrl.description: Public https URL of the JWKS to verify with (optional)

token.description: The JWT, three base64url parts separated by dots (up to 16 KB)
